name: t100_bb_new1
headline: Human Written
windows: What I found, once I started cultivating my own happiness, was that I got a lot better at helping other people toward theirs. That might not be how it goes for everyone, and it doesn’t mean unhappy people can’t help. Do your part for people who are suffering, and skip the part where you have to be miserable too.

name: t100_guide5
headline: Human Written
windows: Once a need does show, after all that hiding, it’s okay to want a lot of closeness. So then someone you love goes for a walk alone, and you’ve texted “hello??” before they’re at the corner. When they get back, you sulk all night. Wanting them close is fine! But they get to go for a walk too. Ask your little one what it’s afraid of. I think it just wants to know they’re coming back. Then the Guide can come up with something like “See you in an hour?”

name: t100_ended1
headline: Human Written
windows: Your little one can get really loud in the gap after one life ends and before the next one has formed. A breakup will do it, or moving to another country, an illness, losing your faith or a role, your youngest moving out. Maybe you’ve left a family or community, maybe you’ve stayed on new terms. A therapist or helper might step back because you’re doing so much better, and suddenly your little one is wailing. For a while the old you is gone and the new you hasn’t shown up yet. Tibetan Buddhism calls an in-between state like that a bardo (I’m only borrowing the word, so what it teaches about death and rebirth is up to you).

name: t100_ifs7
headline: Human Written
windows: And the parts just keep coming: managers, firefighters, exiles, polarized parts, legacy burdens, Self-energy, guides, new subparts... At some point it’s a maze, with a little one somewhere in the middle of it. Some practitioners are gentle about it and walk you through the maze just fine.
Others seem to leave people more split up than when they started.
I wouldn’t trust a model more just because there’s a big institute behind it handing out certificates.
